paragraphs: Active Network sells activity management software to communities and organizers. Its markets span camps, classes, education, endurance events and parks. The company frames this as scalable management solutions for organizations and municipalities around the world.

Email and SMS tools let an organization or municipality get the word out about what it offers. Reporting and analytics are customizable. The company says its business is routinely and independently assessed for compliance to various security standards. A custom organization app powered by ACTIVENet or Camp & Class Manager gives access to core functionality at any hour.

The company states that it operates across 103 countries. Its history page records that ACTIVE Network was acquired by Vista Equity Partners. The same page notes the opening of its Dallas headquarters. Earlier entries list the acquisition of ReserveAmerica and a strategic alliance agreement with DigitalTown.

quote.text: ACTIVE offers a variety of scalable management solutions to organizations and municipalities making a positive impact within their communities around the world.
